# Made by Human

> Official machine-readable information about Made by Human for search and AI discovery.

Made by Human is a certification scheme for physical products with verifiably human production. It evaluates whether the essential, product-defining manufacturing steps are carried out by people and makes certification status publicly verifiable.

Official website: https://madebyhuman.org/
English website: https://madebyhuman.org/en/
Operator: D&G Handels GmbH, Paderborn, Germany
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/madebyhuman.verify/
Official LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/made-by-human-org/

## Key facts

- Official name: Made by Human (singular).
- Current normative German standard: Made by Human Standard 1.0, published 14 September 2026.
- Standard 1.0 is the first binding version used for real certifications; version 0.1 remains archived.
- A regular certification applies to a defined physical product or product family, not automatically to an entire company.
- Product variants may share one certification scope only when their defining production steps, automation level, relevant production locations and important external manufacturing are substantially the same.
- Tools and machines may support production; largely autonomous product creation does not meet the standard.
- Human involvement must materially shape the product. Merely starting, monitoring or unloading an otherwise autonomous process is not sufficient.
- All mandatory criteria applicable to the defined certification scope must be fulfilled.
- A pure self-declaration is not sufficient; the relevant production process is checked on site and against suitable evidence.
- Regular certifications are normally valid for 12 months and are reassessed before renewal.
- Material changes to production, automation, production locations or important external manufacturing must be reported.
- Mark use requires an active regular certification status and is limited to the certified scope.
- A provider that is identical to the scheme owner or under common legal or economic control cannot receive a regular Made by Human certification. The standard may be applied as a disclosed connected pilot assessment instead.
- A connected pilot assessment is not a regular certification or independent third-party assessment and does not authorize use of the certification mark.
- For regular certifications, the certification decision is not made solely by the person who conducted the material on-site assessment.
- Made by Human does not claim accreditation unless accreditation actually exists and can be substantiated.
- The certification does not by itself make claims about sustainability, origin, general product quality, product safety or regulatory compliance.
- The English standard page is an explanatory translation; the published German Standard 1.0 is the normative reference.
